nodes.label: E2EE Zero-Trust Security Architecture
nodes.rationale: End-to-end encryption architecture: TLS 1.3/1.2 for external traffic, internal PKI with auto-generated certificates, AES-256-GCM (Fernet) for data at-rest, MultiFernet key rotation. Encrypts API keys, pipeline states, event payloads, and read models. Refuses production startup without ENCRYPTION_KEY.
